title: BumbleShards
description:
The best shards plugin for your minecraft server for versions 1.21-1.21.x

Consists 10 shards, admin commands, life system and much more.
body:
# BumbleShards

Plugin Made By - .tgvampire 

Plugin Overview:

This plugin consists of 10 shards each consisting its 3 tiers, upon first join player is given a random shard and other shards can be obtained through admin commands. Support LuckPerms or any other permission plugin. Support for Life System. The plugin is totally configurable.
